labels.look: White, centred red 'MORISTON' wordmark with a blue 'Edit Me!' sticker, tagline below, short paragraph, pay-what-you-want card with riso print photo
labels.ux: Name and tagline are one contenteditable block; 'Get Moriston' CTA in a promo card
labels.learn: A small 'Edit Me!' sticker on the headline turns the hero itself into a tester without adding any UI

labels.look: Split screen: dark green left with ASCII-style tree, stars and the name; black right with every park name as running text, size and weight sliders
labels.ux: Size and weight sliders restyle the list of park names live
labels.learn: Use a list of real names from the font's world (all the parks) as the default tester text

labels.look: Full-width 'MD NICHROME' in hairline plus black weights, small foundry badge, black-to-grey grain gradient
labels.learn: Setting the prefix in the thinnest weight and the name in the heaviest shows the weight range inside the wordmark

labels.variantDefinition: Split hero: name, one-line pitch and CTA on one side, a single oversized glyph as the image on the other
labels.look: Black, white name and tagline left, outlined 'Download for free' button, award badges, huge blurred white 'O' right
labels.ux: Download button; glyph animates in (tile caught it mid-slide)
labels.learn: Blurring the hero glyph like an eye-test letter makes the font's origin (optotypes) felt before it is read

labels.look: Green sticky tab bar, big dark 'OVERPASS', grey GitHub and green OTF buttons, CDN CSS URLs; cut also includes the next sections
labels.ux: GitHub and download buttons; read-only inputs that select the webfont URL on click
labels.learn: Put the copy-ready webfont embed URL in the hero: for open-source fonts, installation is the CTA

labels.look: Black, chrome-rendered 3D 'POLYCHROME' with iridescent hyperspace light streaks
labels.learn: A rendered 3D video of the wordmark sells a display face as an object, not just letters

labels.look: Black, centred white 'PP FRAGMENT' with SANS / GLARE / SERIF / TEXT labels under it, floating glass shards, 'Get the font' button
labels.ux: Letters roll slot-machine style through the sub-families; shards drift; sticky top bar
labels.learn: Rolling each letter through the sub-families shows the whole superfamily inside the name

labels.look: Full-bleed photo of a white modernist house with oval cut-outs; blue box with 'frama'; orange info cards ('Celebrating Geometry', 'Play of Proportion')
labels.ux: Scroll moves the orange cards over the photo; 'Get the font' button
labels.learn: Choose a photo whose geometry rhymes with the letterforms (ovals, slabs) so the image explains the design

labels.variantDefinition: The family name presented as a dictionary entry (syllables, part of speech, numbered senses, etymology), using the family's weights and italics for the entry's hierarchy
labels.look: Peach newspaper page 'The Daily Prospectus' over grey with orange blobs; serif definition with bold, italic and small caps
labels.ux: The page text is editable (caret after the masthead)
labels.learn: A dictionary entry is a natural excuse to show roman, italic, bold and small text in one short block
